题目.题目1:
【听力】听录音，回答问题：说话人的家在哪里？
听：My house is situated near a lake.
A. 山上
B. 湖边
C. 市中心
D. 海边
题目.题目2:
【单项选择】选出最恰当的一项。
题干：The school is ______ in the centre of the town.
A. situate
B. situation
C. situated
D. situating
题目.题目3:
【选词填空】从 situated、situation 中选一个，用适当形式填空。
题干：I don't know what to do in this ______.
考点：词性转换
题目.题目4:
【适当形式填空】用所给单词的适当形式填空。
题干：They decided to ______ the new hospital by the river. (situated)
考点：变形
题目.题目5:
【改错】句子里有一处错误，找出来并改正。
题干：The hotel situates near the airport.
考点：用法
题目.题目6:
【单项选择】选出最恰当的一项。
题干：In spoken English, people often say "be ______" instead of "be situated".
A. location
B. located
C. locate
D. locating
考点：易混
题目.题目7:
【单项选择】选出最恰当的一项。
题干："The farm is situated by the river" means ______.
A. The farm is far from the river.
B. The farm is by the river.
C. The river is in the farm.
D. The farm moved away.
考点：用法
题目.答案:
【1】B（湖边）
讲解：be situated 位于。
【2】C（situated）
讲解：be situated 位于。
【3】situation
讲解：this 后面要名词 situation。
【4】situate
讲解：to 后面接动词原形 situate。
【5】situates → is situated
讲解：“位于”要用 be situated。
【6】B（located）
讲解：口语多说 be located。
【7】B（The farm is by the river.）
讲解：be situated 就是“在……地方”。
